prompt:
Style: a hand-painted 2D background for a story-driven cartoon adventure game, drawn like the background of a classic hand-drawn animated film: clean, confident dark brown ink outlines around every object, soft painted cel shading with two or three tones per surface, light painted texture on stone and wood, simplified and readable shapes, moderate detail (no fine clutter, no fine rigging; each mast is one clean line). Colours: true, natural local colours at medium saturation (a white lighthouse with one red band, grey and ochre stones, warm brown wood, dark green-grey rocks, a dark slate roof, a blue-green sea). Light: this picture is the neutral daytime base plate of a game location; the game engine will later recolour it into dusk, night, rain, fog and snow with colour grading, light masks and particle layers. Therefore paint it in soft, even, diffuse daylight from a bright, lightly clouded midday sky: no sunset, no orange or pink horizon, no strong cast shadows, no dramatic contrast, no glow, no lit windows, no lit lamps, no stars, no mist. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not glossy CGI, not an oil painting, not a postcard.

Layout: camera at slightly raised eye level looking across the harbour; the horizon is straight and level at about 45 % of the picture height. A large open sky fills the upper part of the picture, with a few soft, separate white clouds and large clear gaps of pale blue. A large calm area of open water fills the middle of the picture; the edges where the water meets the quay, the jetty, the boats and the rocks are clean and readable. The cottage stands in the left fifth of the picture; the top of its chimney is seen against open sky. The lantern post stands on the quay at about one quarter of the picture width. The short wooden jetty with the two boats is in the centre; the two boats lie side by side on open water and do not overlap each other. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at about four fifths of the picture width; its lamp room is seen against open sky, with clear sky to its left and right. The stone quay fills the bottom quarter of the picture as a wide, plain, flat surface of large stone slabs; the barrels, the crates and the rope coil stand on the left near the cottage, while the middle and the right part of the quay are plain stone without any props (a character will stand next to the lantern, and a text box will cover the lower right). Keep the top tenth and the bottom tenth of the picture free of important details, because the picture will be cropped to a wide 16:9 screen.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

Light and effects for this picture: the location text above describes the harbour at dusk; this picture is the neutral daytime version of exactly that harbour, painted in daylight as described in the style. The window of the cottage is unlit: dark blue-grey glass in a clearly drawn window frame. The glass of the iron lantern is unlit clear glass, and the lamp room of the lighthouse is unlit glass. There is no band of orange light at the horizon and there are no stars; the sky is pale clear blue with a few soft white clouds. Effects that the game adds later are not painted at all: no light beam from the lighthouse, no smoke from the chimney, no birds, no rain, no snow, no fog, no reflections of lights on the water.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Turn the attached painting into a grayscale depth map for a game engine; it will be used to add distance fog. Keep the composition, the outlines, the positions and the proportions of the attached image exactly, as if traced on a clear sheet laid on top of it: the same framing, the same horizon height, the same size and place of every object. Brightness only encodes the distance from the camera: near is white, far is black. The stone slabs at the bottom edge of the picture are pure white; the quay floor gets smoothly darker towards the back; the water surface continues this smooth gradient from light grey at the quay edge to very dark grey at the horizon; the far islands on the horizon are very dark grey; the whole sky including all clouds is pure black. Upright objects have the grey of the ground at their foot, only slightly lighter on parts that come closer to the camera: the cottage, the barrels, the crates and the rope coil light grey, the lantern post and the jetty a little darker, the boats mid grey, the lighthouse, its small house and the rocky headland dark grey, clearly lighter than the horizon behind them. Smooth, continuous gradients with clean, sharp edges between objects at different distances: no texture, no outlines, no light and shadow, no brush strokes, no noise, no colour.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Turn the attached painting into a flat colour-coded segmentation map for a game engine. Keep the composition, the outlines, the positions and the proportions of the attached image exactly, as if traced on a clear sheet laid on top of it: the same framing, the same horizon height, the same size and place of every object. Replace every area by one flat, pure, fully saturated colour with hard, clean edges: no shading, no texture, no brush strokes, no outlines, no gradients, no glow, no halos, no details inside the areas. It is a technical map, not a picture: do not keep any colour of the attached painting, use only the colour codes below. Colour codes: the whole sky including all clouds, down to the horizon and down to the outlines of the land, the rocks, the cottage, the chimney, the lantern and its post and the lighthouse: pure blue #0000FF. All open water of the sea and the harbour, including every reflection on the water and the water between the jetty posts: pure cyan #00FFFF. The two fishing boats including hulls, cabins, masts and their ropes: pure magenta #FF00FF. Only the glass panes of the cottage window (not the window frame, not the wall): pure yellow #FFFF00. Only the glass of the iron lantern on the wooden post (not its iron frame, not the post): pure orange #FF8000. Only the glass of the lamp room at the top of the lighthouse: pure red #FF0000. The chimney pots on top of the cottage chimney: pure green #00FF00. Everything else (land, rocks, the headland, the cottage walls, door and roof, the chimney stack, the lighthouse tower and the small house next to it, the quay, the jetty and its posts, barrels, crates, rope, the lantern post and arm): pure black #000000. Use no other colours, and do not add, remove or move any object.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Repaint the attached painting as exactly the same picture after a fresh snowfall. This is a technical layer for a game engine that will cut the snow out by comparing it with the attached image, so everything except the snow must stay exactly as in the attached image: the same framing, the same horizon height, every object at the same place and in the same size, the same outlines and line style, the same colours, the same soft daylight, the same blue sky with the same clouds, the same water. Only add a layer of fresh, clean white snow, drawn in the same cartoon style (white with soft light blue-grey shading and the same dark brown outline along its lower edge), lying on all upward-facing surfaces: the roof of the cottage, the top of the chimney, the window sill and the top of the door frame, the tops of the barrels and the crates, the rope coil, the top of the lantern and of its arm, the top of the lantern post, the planks of the jetty and the tops of its posts, the gunwales and cabin roofs of the boats, the tops of the rocks and the grassy slopes of the headland and of the far islands, the roof and the gallery of the lighthouse and the roof of the small house next to it. The stone quay is covered by an even layer of snow, with some slab edges and dark joints still showing through. The water stays open water without snow or ice. No falling snowflakes in the air (they are added later as particles), no footprints, no fog, no icicles, no change of the light or of the sky.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Repaint the attached painting as exactly the same picture at night. This is a technical key for a game engine that will measure the colour change and the light pools by comparing it with the attached image, so everything must stay exactly as in the attached image: the same framing, the same horizon height, every object at the same place and in the same size, the same outlines and the same cartoon line style with soft painted cel shading. Only the light changes: a clear night under a deep blue sky; the whole scene dark, cool and blue, colours desaturated as seen at night but every object still readable, the clouds dark blue-grey. The glass panes of the cottage window are lit from inside with warm yellow-orange light, which casts a soft warm pool of light on the wall around the window and on the stones below it. The iron lantern on the wooden post is lit with a warm flame and casts a round warm pool of light on the quay around the post, on the post itself and on the nearby crates, barrels and stones, fading softly into the blue night. The lamp room of the lighthouse is lit as a small bright warm spot. Soft, broken warm reflections of the window, the lantern and the lighthouse lamp on the water. No moon, no stars, no beam or rays from the lighthouse, no smoke, no birds, no fog, no rain, no glow halos in the sky.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
